description: This file defines the RootComposer class which provides methods to access and manipulate the root composer.json and composer.lock files within a Drupal project, including reading, updating, and writing these files, as well as verifying consistency between the composer content and the root package.

classes.name: RootComposer
classes.description: A class that manages reading, updating, and writing the root composer.json and composer.lock files, and verifying their consistency within a Drupal project.

methods.name: getComposerManipulator
methods.description: Returns a JsonManipulator instance for the root composer.json contents.

methods.name: getComposerLockedContent
methods.description: Retrieves the current locked content of the composer.json.

methods.name: removeFromComposerLock
methods.description: Removes an element from the composer lock data by key and index.

methods.name: addToComposerLock
methods.description: Adds an element to the composer lock data under a specified key.

methods.name: writeFiles
methods.description: Writes updates to composer.json, composer.lock, and installed package files, ensuring consistency and updating the lock data.
